pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions (no scaling in) within 30 minutes of a prior stopped-out order on the same instrument.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Order execution strictly blocked unless ATR-normalized volume confirms trend exhaustion and order-book imbalance exceeds 1.5 standard deviations.
profit_harvest_threshold: Immediate partial harvest triggered upon reaching +$5.00 unrealized, with trailing stop locked to breakeven + spread.
